notes.title: The Story Contest Returns!
notes.content:
Hey Dark Lords – old-timers and newcomers!

The long-awaited Dark Lord release took place yesterday, and we’re here now to announce a community contest! The story writing competition is an ancient tradition of this community, and it's time to bring it back! To be a successful Dark Lord, one needs to be creative, so show off your best works and etch your name into the history of our game!

How to join:

 Settle into your throne, delve into the depths of your imagination, and bring your ideas to life. Before you begin, ensure you know the competition's rules and guidelines below.
 Submit your masterpieces via our very cool and handy in-game Community Stories mode editor no later than September 1st.
 Don’t forget to add [Contest] to the title of your story (you can change it after the contest ends).
 Once submitted, take pride in your work, read other creators’ stories, and wait for September 6th, the day that we announce the results!
Prizes galore

Your story can span any genre—dramatic, comedic, mystical, or even meme-inspired. The authors of the best tales will be rewarded handsomely:

 1st Place: $1000
 2nd Place: $500
 3rd Place: $250
Note: the prizes are distributed via Amazon or Steam gift cards (read the contest’s Terms and Conditions for more details).

Competition guidelines


 Watch our demo guide for creating stories.
 Entries must have a minimum of 30 cards and 15 steps (if you follow the shortest path), each with a situation description and two choice options. Don't forget to choose an avatar for each card, and also choose a picture.
 Each participant may submit up to 3 stories, but can only win once.
 Only original works made specifically for this contest are eligible.
 By entering, you agree that if your story wins, it may be used for marketing, advertising, or other related purposes.
 Full terms and conditions are available on our Discord server.

Good luck, and may inspiration flow abundantly!

notes.title: Dark Lord is released and more surprises are inside!
notes.content:
Greetings, Dark Lords!

The moment we've all been waiting for has finally arrived—you can now dive into the mysterious story of the Dark Lord absolutely FREE! We want to thank everyone who played our demo and for their support and feedback, without you, the final game wouldn't be what it is today!

[previewyoutube=RAAQf1DI7Lk;full][/previewyoutube]

Step into the treacherous yet enticing shoes of the Dark Lord as you navigate a realm filled with eccentric characters and intricate plots. Expand your dark influence across new lands, and master the delicate balance between political intrigue and military might. Manage advisors who are as likely to stab you in the back as they would kneel before you in awe.

As you fortify your stronghold, you'll also dive into a narrative that continuously unfolds and is layered with deliciously dark humor. The cherry on top is the special Community Stories Mode. In this mode, you can explore the tales crafted by other players, as well as create and share your adventures using our editor.

But that's not all! What’s a great game without DLCs? We have three available now, with more on the way!

 Disenchanting Ritual DLC: An exclusive story about the Cat—your oddly intelligent furry companion - and yes, you read that correctly! Is there more to this pet than meets the eye? Put your trust in the Dark Wizard, perform the disenchantment ritual, and reveal the true nature of the Cat. What secrets will be uncovered, and where will this whimsical journey lead? It's time to find out!
 Forbidden Magic DLC: Link your Steam account with the LTG Platform to access a unique story about your loyal magical advisor! In this two-episode tale, you will have to help the Dark Wizard uncover the secrets of the forbidden arts and achieve the ultimate mastery of magic. This adventure will be one of the most dangerous you'll face because, as you know, forbidden magic is no laughing matter! 
 Supporter Pack: A pack where you can show your gratitude to the developers! This pack includes additional visual content that will enhance your gaming experience, allowing you to enjoy new appearances for your cards, fresh visual effects, and other unique elements that make your journey much more special!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/1443c71fcac8494d98601db3673d310d160c27b2.png
Good luck with your adventures in the dark realms! Don’t forget to share your thoughts on the final game and join our community to stay updated on the latest news!

notes.title: Story Contest Results!
notes.content:
Hey Dark Lords!

After much anticipation, we've completed our dive into your incredible submissions. It's clear you all poured your hearts into this, making our choice a challenging one! With over 35 unique tales submitted, we navigated through 1,800+ narrative cards, saw over 90 endings, and fell for our characters all over again. We evaluated these tales based on their content, intrigue, length, nonlinearity, and the diversity of endings—true to the spirit of Dark Lord, where every choice matters. But, as with any contest not held in a kindergarten, winners must be crowned. So, without further ado, here are our champions:

1st place and $1000 goes to Drunk Lord by @Lach_2110

With a staggering 256 passages, Drunk Lord takes first place for its sheer scope, engaging plot, multiple endings, and brilliant humor. 

“Welcome to Drunk Lord! Face your greatest foe: your drunken self. The Dark Lord wakes after a wild night on the town, having misplaced the legendary sword, Lordsbane. In the wrong hands, it could spell the end of your kingdom. Getting it back is your utmost priority. Or is it? Navigate this text-based adventure however you desire. It's Dark Lord meets The Hangover, with a dash of Morrowind. Choose your path or shirk your responsibilities. Uncover the mystery. With six possible endings and numerous game-play choices, Drunk Lord rewards curiosity and is designed to be played more than once.”

2nd place and $750 goes to The Sealed City by @giyuga

Naturally, the community story mode embraces both the light-hearted and the profound. This is why we were captivated by a story that unveils a new and enigmatic realm within the Dark Lord universe.

“You’ve been awoken in the dead of night by an earthquake! Turns out it have broken not only your slumber but also the nearby mountain. With this came miraculous news — there was a city under this mountain all along. Are there still people there? Are they friends or foes? There is only one way to find out!
This epic non-linear adventure has several endings, battles, magic, mystery and a lot of danger for a reckless Dark Lord. Will you perish? Or will you uncover the mystery of The Sealed City?”

3rd place and $500 goes to The Cat Lord by @yarseit

Capturing our affection for felines—which many of you noticed—The Cat Lord emerged as the top "cat" narrative. 

“What? Someone turned the Dark Lord into a cat? What kind of impudence is this? You need to figure it out.”

But that's not all! The sheer volume and quality of submissions deserve special recognition. So, we're awarding a $50 People's Choice Award to these remarkable stories:


 Catocalypse by @alastor9000
 My pal—the Paladin by @anna19952558
 The Bone Dragon by @keldalas
 Meteorite and witch by @vdm_blgkv
 The Secret Expedition by @nikiprotiv
 The Labyrinth of Love by Ekaterina Golub
 Dark Lord Story by Michael Sychov
 Traitorous Knight by @shamesash


We'd love to sing praises for each submission, as they've truly moved us and deserve every bit of acclaim. However, the Internet might just run out of space if we tried! Instead, keep an eye out for the upcoming story editor release—soon, you'll have the chance to showcase your masterpiece to the world. The wait is almost over! (wink-wink)

We'll reach out to all winners to arrange prize distribution (please check your Discord privacy settings). These stories are being translated and will soon be added to the game for everyone to enjoy. Thank you for your participation, and we look forward to seeing your creativity in future contests!

We are happy to share some great news – we are taking part in Steam Next Fest, which is taking place from February 5 to 12!

Surely, we couldn’t arrive at the festival empty-handed. Here’s the list of changes we implemented for the game!


 Added new images for the choice cards for more visual variety in cards and wider creative possibilities for you in the future!

Add Dark Lord to your wishlist, leave your sinister reviews, join our Discord server, and spread the word in your dark circles!

notes.title: The Legendary Stories Contest Begins!
notes.content:
Listen up, Dark Lords!

Lay down your sword and arm yourself with the mightiest weapon of all—your brilliantly twisted mind. The story-writing competition has started! You’re in for not just cash prizes, but also fame, honor, and a chance to etch your name in history (or at least in our game).

How to join the fray?
Settle into your throne, delve into the depths of your imagination, and bring your ideas to life. Before you begin, ensure you're familiar with the competition's rules and guidelines detailed below.
Submit your masterpieces in .twee format together with the name of your work, its short description (up to 600 characters) and your Discord tag to community@longtalegames.com with the subject ‘Dark Lord Contest’ before February 11.
Once submitted, take pride in your work and await the results.

Prizes galore

Your stories can span any genre—dramatic, comedic, mystical, or even meme-inspired. The authors of the best tales will be rewarded handsomely:

1st Place: $1000
2nd Place: $750
3rd Place: $500

Bonus: Your story featured in the game for all to see!

Additionally, special $50 cash incentives are up for grabs to ensure no hidden gem goes unnoticed.

Competition guidelines
Submissions are accepted exclusively via community@longtalegames.com 
Format: Diagrams in Twine. Requirements for the format of the work and instructions for preparation can be found here.
And here is a quick guide to converting your idea into a game story.
Entries must have a minimum of 30 cards and 15 steps along the shortest path, each with a situation description and two choice options. Don't forget to choose an avatar for each card and choose a picture.
Each participant may submit up to 5 stories, but only one can claim a prize.
Only original works crafted specifically for this contest are eligible.
By entering, you agree that if your story wins, it may be used for marketing, advertising, or other related purposes.
Full terms and conditions are available on our Discord.
Good luck, and may inspiration flow abundantly!
